description:
Generate a chat completion using a Mistral model.

When to use:
- Drafting French (or any European-language) content where Mistral shines.
- Codestral for code-specific generation/review.
- Ministral for cheap / low-latency classification.

Returns structured content with the assistant text and token usage.
Does NOT stream — use mistral_chat_stream for long outputs with progress updates.

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate. Input tokens plus this limit must fit within the model's context length.

role.description: Message author: system for instructions, user for requests, or assistant for prior replies.

model.description: Chat model. Default: mistral-medium-latest (override with MISTRAL_DEFAULT_MODEL).

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort; supported values depend on the selected model.

type.description: Generate plain text without a JSON format constraint.
Generate JSON. Also instruct the model to produce JSON in a system or user message.

json_schema.description: Named JSON Schema and optional strictness for the generated response.

description.description: Description of the response the schema defines.

name.description: Identifier for the schema; surfaced in API errors.

schema.description: JSON Schema object the response must conform to.

strict.description: If true, the API rejects responses that do not strictly match the schema.

type.description: Generate JSON conforming to the supplied json_schema.

response_format.description: Force a structured output: `{type:"json_object"}` for JSON mode, `{type:"json_schema", json_schema:{...}}` for strict schema mode.

seed.description: Random seed for deterministic sampling. Maps to Mistral's `random_seed`.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature: higher values make output more random; lower values make it more focused. Prefer adjusting this or top_p, not both.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling probability mass: 0.1 considers tokens in the top 10% of probability mass. Prefer adjusting this or temperature, not both.

name: mistral_chat

reasoning_content.description: Reasoning trace returned by Magistral models. Absent for non-reasoning models.

title: Mistral chat completion
